title: Squall
text: A squall comes out of a clear sky and throws the ship onto its side.

pass.text: You help the crew hold the ship steady.

fail.text: You are thrown against the rail. The ship limps into port a day late.

title: Man Overboard
text: A man is in the water off the port side. No one aboard recognizes him, and the nearest land is hundreds of miles away.

pass.text: You haul him aboard. He thanks you in a language no one speaks, then points at the horizon and dies.

fail.text: He sinks without a sound. He was smiling.

title: The Captain's Table
text: The captain invites you to dinner. He collects stories, and pays well for good ones.

pass.text: He likes your story so much that he refunds your passage.

title: Strange Cargo
text: In the hold, a crate stamped with a museum's name has started to scratch from the inside.

outcomes.text: Inside, packed in straw, is an artifact of great power.
Rats, only rats, and a forgotten case of supplies.

title: Lights Below
text: Green lights glow far beneath the hull, in a pattern like streets.

pass.text: You sketch the pattern before it fades.

fail.text: You cannot stop looking, and something below starts looking back.

title: The Stowaway
text: You catch someone hiding in a lifeboat. They beg you not to tell the captain.

pass.text: The stowaway is running from the same thing you are chasing. They join you.

fail.text: In the morning the stowaway is gone, and so is your purse.

title: Dreams at Sea
text: Every passenger aboard has the same dream on the same night.

pass.text: You understand the dream, and it is a warning.

fail.text: You do not want to sleep again.

title: An Uncharted Island
text: The ship anchors off an island that is on no chart. The captain lets you go ashore for one hour.

pass.text: In a ruined temple at the island's heart you find something old and powerful.

fail.text: Something in the jungle has been waiting a long time for visitors.

title: Mutiny
text: The crew say the voyage is cursed and want to turn back. The mates have pistols out.

effects.prompt: How do you stop the mutiny?

pass.text: The crew go back to work, and the grateful captain pays you.

fail.text: Someone throws a punch, and then everyone does.

pass.text: You hold the bridge until the crew calm down.

fail.text: You are knocked down the ladder.

title: Fog Bank
text: The ship sails into fog so thick that the bow disappears. Bells ring somewhere ahead.

pass.text: You read the stars through a gap in the fog and set the course.

fail.text: Three days in the fog, and the bells never stop.
